Excel workbook generation failed due to #N/A errors in lookup and derived value matrices.
The test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats failed with multiple AssertionError messages. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned '#N/A' instead of the expected numeric values (e.g., H12 expected 418.2, H35 expected 2.423). This indicates a failure in the Excel formula logic or data mapping within the 'Task' worksheet. While the file and sheet structure passed, the core calculation matrices are broken.
